global_prompt: Cinematic live-action continuity study, natural skin texture, physically plausible movement, coherent geography, no captions or text overlays.

characters.Mara: A woman in her early thirties with a short copper bob, a teal scarf, a crescent-shaped scar above her left eyebrow, and a mustard raincoat.
characters.Niko: A tall man with close-cropped black hair wearing a charcoal mechanic jacket.
characters.Iris: A woman with long auburn hair wearing a rust-coloured coat and a navy wool hat.
characters.Tomas: An older street vendor with silver hair, round glasses, and a green apron.

chunks.content: Medium close-up at a rainy tram stop: Mara turns toward camera, lowers her umbrella, and checks a brass pocket watch. Her short copper bob, teal scarf, crescent-shaped scar above her left eyebrow, and mustard raincoat are clearly visible; slow push-in, soft overcast daylight.
Wide tracking shot beside the tram depot: Niko rolls a bicycle through wet reflections while commuters cross behind him; the camera moves left to right and the established woman is absent.
Inside a moving tram, Iris stands near the rear doors and folds a city map. Her long auburn hair and rust-coloured coat create a deliberately similar colour distractor; handheld aisle composition.
Low-angle exterior at a market arcade: Tomas closes a striped awning as rainwater spills from its edge; pedestrians pass in deep background and no earlier principal character is present.
Overhead view of Niko repairing a loose bicycle chain under a station canopy, with rapid hand movement and a train sliding through the far background.
Static profile composition inside a small cafe: Iris removes her navy hat, places the folded map beside a cup, and looks through a fogged window; warm tungsten light contrasts the rainy exterior.
Long-lens street view: Tomas hands a paper parcel to Niko across the market counter while umbrellas sweep through foreground occlusion; neither looks toward camera.
Fast lateral dolly along the departing tram: Iris is briefly visible through a window, then disappears behind repeating metal pillars; cool dusk light and strong motion parallax.

From a high three-quarter angle on the opposite platform, Mara re-enters at dusk, runs two steps, catches the closing tram door with one hand, then looks up toward camera; dynamic wide composition with rain and moving commuters.
